subject: How to select multiple items from a list and send them to a vector in the UI

messages.author: 4993baedf1224ac5
messages.subject: How to select multiple items from a list and send them to a vector in the UI
parts:
I have built a Baseline Table builder that calls on colnames from a table in the UI and lets one choose which variables to include.  Currently the only way I can make this happen is using multiple "selectinput" calls.  Is there any way to select a number of variables from a list so that you dont have to have a long list of selectinput's in your UI.

Something like:

from
colnames          sent to a vector

age
gender
height  ------>     gender
weight               weight
etc.


Thanks,
Hugh
